waves.title: Money that is wrong today
waves.rule: Money moves incorrectly, or entitlements do not match what was paid for.

tasks.what: Admin 'Change plan' always calls subscribe - full non-prorated charge AND a reset billing period. Every admin-initiated plan change overcharges.
tasks.note: DONE per registry status (F18 3/3 done) — listed here only so the wave shows its history; do not rework.

tasks.what: platform-admin updatePlan (platform-admin.service.ts ~379) does a raw tx.tenant.update + tenantSubscription.upsert with basePriceSnapshot — no proration, no Stripe sync. B58 fixed the TENANT-facing change-plan path only; the ADMIN path is the same defect, unfiled. Files when 0d mints.
disableAddon nulls stripeItemId even when the Stripe delete failed - tenant keeps paying for a disabled add-on and the pointer to stop it is gone.
tasks.note: DONE per registry status (F18 3/3 done) — listed here only so the wave shows its history; do not rework.

tasks.what: The 3-day payment-grace suspension can never fire - non-payers are never suspended.
Reinstating a lapsed tenant does not clear a downgrade armed before the lapse; it fires later against a paying tenant.
tasks.note: Adjacent to the in-flight billing lane; fold in there if that lands first.

tasks.what: Enabling a priced add-on twice creates two Stripe subscription items and keeps one pointer - double billing, one handle.
rollCycles drifts the billing anchor day and drops the period time-of-day.
subscribe() on an off-catalog published plan key writes currentPlan as the STARTER enum shadow - wrong entitlements, silently.
A trial tenant cannot cancel - signup writes no TenantSubscription row for the cancel path to act on.
READ_ONLY never surfaces in the web UI; a lapsed tenant gets a degraded product with no explanation.
In-app cancel never propagates to Stripe; onPaymentSucceeded then resurrects the tenant. Exposure at time of fix: ZERO (verified, no tenant holds a stripeSubId).
POST /billing/quote missing from the READ_ONLY allowlist, so the Choose-a-plan CTA 403s and loops. Was Phase 0 task 7; reassigned.

waves.title: The admin seat: impersonation and isolation
waves.rule: An admin acting on a tenant must not leak across tenants, and must be auditable.
waves.parallelWhy: Touches auth/impersonation/mobile-session files; B1 touches billing/*. Disjoint - no worktree contention.

tasks.what: Impersonation keeps the previous tenant's logo, business name and username.
tasks.note: DONE per registry status (F33 6/6 done) — listed here only so the wave shows its history; do not rework.

tasks.what: Signing out during impersonation deletes every refresh token of the REAL tenant admin.
Mobile sign-out never clears the query cache - the next tenant sees the previous tenant's figures.
Developer Mode silently overrode per-tenant delivery toggles and the dispatch API.
tasks.note: DONE per registry status (F33 6/6 done) — listed here only so the wave shows its history; do not rework.

tasks.what: The impersonation guard can never fire - impersonated writes are audited as the tenant's own admin. Audit is blind exactly when it matters most.
An impersonation timeout bounces the admin silently and leaves the tenant cookie set.
Signed OAuth state (HKDF from JWT_SECRET) - already built in another lane; land it, do not rebuild.
Platform-admin MFA + recovery (Phase 2 of the umbrella spec). Single SUPER_ADMIN account has no second factor today.

waves.title: Tenant lifecycle completeness
waves.rule: Every state a tenant can reach has a way out, and somebody is told when it is reached.

tasks.what: CANCELLED is a hard dead end - 403 on every method INCLUDING GET, no banner, no CTA; only platform-admin updateStatus restores. GATING PRECONDITION: do not enable Stripe checkout for any real tenant until CANCELLED has a path back (self-serve resubscribe, or at minimum read-only data access + support CTA). STRIPE-CANCEL-1 makes this state reachable by a self-service click.
Tenant admins are auto-created as drivers, and deleting the driver row silently rolls back.
tasks.note: DONE per registry status (F33 6/6 done) — listed here only so the wave shows its history; do not rework.

tasks.what: A scheduled downgrade deactivates every seat over cap with no way to choose which ones.
A failed re-quote on choose-plan clears the summary card with no error toast.
The mobile tenant-admin dashboard is unreachable - no role ever routes there.

Phase 4 lifecycle messaging - event-triggered emails on the existing notify() engine, owner alerts, and the legacy READ_ONLY-with-live-Stripe cohort alert (currently a log warn nobody reads). Needs the real outbound transport.
